fusions.name: Snagging Filament
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand-trailing locust at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach. It moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Snares
fusions.desc: Casts a net of strands and swarm over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour, with a 40% chance per hit to leave them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Screen
fusions.desc: Raises a felted wall of locusts 6 tiles long for 6 seconds that blocks enemies.

fusions.name: Thread Count
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
